column1: # plan-142-A: one line per self-update-shaped builtin overload (the `mfb man`
# census in tests/guards/inplace_self_update_census.rs), plus operator self-updates.
# Driven by tests/runtime/rt_inplace_self_update.rs.
# Columns (tab-separated):
#   signature  exactly as `mfb man` renders it (an operator line has no `::`)
#   status     arm | exempt — `arm`: the statement allocates O(1) per run
#              (count(2N) - count(N) < N/8); `exempt`: `x` is read, never copied (a
#              peak-live-bytes bound). plan-146-A reopens two more, for the `String`
#              lines it adds, each asserting the statement still copies
#              (count(2N) - count(N) >= N): `pending:<letter>`, the plan-146 letter
#              that lands the arm or exemption (plan-146-H deletes it again), and
#              `deferred:<tag>`, a row another plan owns (`attributed-string`,
#              plan-146-A Open Decision 1). Otherwise a line with no arm is a missing
#              arm (plan-142-I).
#   setup      `<type> = <init>` declaring `x`, then optional ` ; <statement>` lines; `{M}` is the size of `x` (see the harness)
#   statement  run each iteration; ` ; ` separates several
#   check      a String expression over `before` (a copy of `x` taken first); printed
#              before and after the loop, it must not change
#   n          optional: iterations for N (default 2000), for a statement too slow for it
